name: crab-crew
description: A crew panel for standard subagents (/crew): each agent type is a crab character with its own role, look and lines, animated by its status and progress.

autoOpen.title: Open the crew panel on the first dispatch

showQuips.title: Crab speech bubbles
showQuips.description: Each crab says what it is up to, in character
